# run_presets

[← Command index](README.md)

Run another JoyBox tool once per platform of a named preset group.

## Synopsis

```
run_presets [options]
```

## Description

A preset group, defined in `Shared/joybox/config/presets.py`, names a game
supercategory, a category and optionally a list of subcategories, such as the Nintendo
handheld and console platforms in `Backup_NintendoGen`. This command runs the chosen
tool (only `backup_tool` so far) once per subcategory, or once for the whole category
when the group lists none, passing `-u`, `-c` and `-s` for each run along with `-o`,
`--skip_existing`, `--skip_identical`, `--verbose` and `--exit_on_failure` as given
here.

Groups: `Backup_Microsoft` and `Backup_OtherGen` (a whole category each),
`Backup_NintendoGen`, `Backup_NintendoSwitch`, `Backup_SonyGen`, `Backup_SonyPS3`,
`Backup_SonyPS4` and `Backup_SonyPSN` (one run per platform).

## Options

### General

| Option | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `-o, --output_path <output_path>` | Destination directory passed to each run as `-o`; it must exist. |
| `-r, --preset_tool_type <backup_tool>` | JoyBox tool to run for each platform. Default: `backup_tool`. Allowed: `backup_tool`. |
| `-g, --preset_option_group_type <preset_option_group_type>` | Preset group naming the platforms to run over; required. Allowed: `Backup_Microsoft`, `Backup_NintendoGen`, `Backup_NintendoSwitch`, `Backup_OtherGen`, `Backup_SonyGen`, `Backup_SonyPS3`, `Backup_SonyPS4`, `Backup_SonyPSN`. |
| `-e, --skip_existing` | Pass `--skip_existing` on, so files already at the destination are skipped. |
| `-i, --skip_identical` | Pass `--skip_identical` on, so files already at the destination with the same content are skipped. |

### Common options

| Option | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `-v, --verbose` | Enable verbose mode. |
| `-p, --pretend_run` | Do a pretend run with no permanent changes. |
| `-x, --exit_on_failure` | Enable exit on failure mode. |
| `--no-preview` | Skip the preview confirmation prompt. |

## Examples

### Back up every Nintendo generation platform to a drive

```bash
run_presets -g Backup_NintendoGen -o /mnt/Backup
```

### Back up the Sony PSN platforms, skipping files already there

```bash
run_presets -g Backup_SonyPSN -o /mnt/Backup -e
```

### Dry run without starting any backup

```bash
run_presets -g Backup_SonyGen -o /mnt/Backup -p -v
```

## Notes

- A failing run is logged and the remaining runs still go ahead.
- `--pretend_run` is not passed on; it stops the runs from starting at all.
